review.tagline: SambaNova Python kits for document RAG, search assistant, function calling
review.summary: Nine Python kits, each with its own README: document text extraction, enterprise and multimodal knowledge retrieval with Streamlit demos, a RAG evaluation kit, a web search assistant, a financial assistant using function calling and scraping, a function-calling module, benchmarking and chat templates. Everything calls SambaNova models through SAMBANOVA_API_KEY. For teams on SambaCloud or SambaStack who want working retrieval code.
review.audience: Teams on SambaNova who want working retrieval code
strengths: Knowledge retriever and search assistant kits include runnable Streamlit demos
Makefile base environment installs Python, Poetry, Tesseract and Poppler; Docker option
weaknesses: SambaNova endpoints only; swapping providers means editing each kit
README states the code is as-is and not production-ready
Mixed notebooks and apps; no single app to fork
Heavy setup: pyenv, Poetry, a parsing service and OCR system packages
